about: A synthetic live notices document as the ops dashboard publishes it (NoticeStore in ops/src/Ember.Ops) and the bot reads it (NoticePoller in src/Ember.Bot). The published document is exactly { "notices": [...] }; this about field is not part of it. A notice: id (letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'), kind (info|maintenance), en, de, and the optional showFrom and showUntil (UTC times ending in Z; left out when absent). Publishing these notices in this order writes this document (ops/tests/Ember.Ops.Tests/NoticeTests.cs), and the bot parses it into id, showFrom, showUntil and en (tests/Ember.Tests/NoticePollerTests.cs).
